body.name: cumulant-SVD quotient GMM
body.construction:
If every environment has at least \(R_{\max}\) observations, construct \(\widehat c_k\) and \(\widehat m_k\) from symmetrized unbiased cumulant U-statistics, set \(\widehat C=[\widehat c_2\mid\cdots\mid\widehat c_{d+1}]\), let \(\widehat Q\) be the orthogonal-complement projector from the rank-\(d\) SVD of \(\widehat C\), and set
\[
 \widehat\beta=\min\operatorname*{arg\,min}_{b\in[-B,B]}
 \max_{d+2\leq k\leq R_{\max}}
 \left\lVert\widehat Q(\widehat m_k-b\widehat c_k)\right\rVert_2.
\]
If some environment has fewer than \(R_{\max}\) observations, set \(\widehat\beta=0\); the sample cumulants and projector are then not used.
